about.title: About Us
about.description1: Sifat Textile is a production leader shaping quality standards for cotton yarn in Uzbekistan. We unite three next-generation factories operating on a unified technological cycle. This structure enables us to provide partners with stable products that meet the expectations of the global market.
about.description2: Each factory is equipped with equipment from top European and Asian brands. This gives us precision in every yarn parameter, control at all stages, and the ability to produce an assortment that meets the requirements of both mass and premium segments of the textile industry. We build our approach on three key principles: raw material purity, technological excellence, and professional responsibility. This allows us to provide partners with yarn that has predictable parameters, stable structure, and long service life of products. Sifat Textile - when yarn becomes a standard of trust.

geography.title: Geography
geography.text: Sifat Textile products are successfully supplied to the domestic market and exported to more than 10 countries, including: China, India, Pakistan, Iran, Egypt, Turkey and European countries. This confirms the high competitiveness and trust of international partners in our brand.

surxon.title: Surxon
surxon.description1: The SURXON SIFAT TEKSTIL plant was founded in 2018 and is located in the Surkhandarya region of Uzbekistan. The enterprise specializes in deep processing of cotton and production of high-quality cotton yarn. Production capacity includes 30,144 spindles, ensuring a full cycle of the spinning process. Annual yarn production reaches 12,000 tons.
surxon.description2: More than 600 specialists work at the plant, a significant portion of whom are young qualified personnel, bringing energy and innovation to production development.
surxon.description3: The main products of the enterprise are combed and carded ring-spun yarn in the range from Ne 6/1 to Ne 40/1. In addition, the plant produces special types of yarn, including Slub yarn — in the range from Ne 6/1 to Ne 30/1.

maroqand.title: Maroqand
maroqand.description1: The Maroqand Sifat Tekstil plant was founded in 2018 and is located in the Samarkand region of Uzbekistan. The main activity of the enterprise is deep processing of cotton and production of high-quality cotton yarn. Annual production exceeds 10,000 tons of yarn.
maroqand.description2: Main products: yarn in the range from Ne 6/1 to Ne 20/1. Special types of yarn, including: • Slub yarn — from Ne 6/1 to Ne 20/1. • Lycra and Dual Core — from Ne 6/1 to Ne 20/1.
maroqand.description3: More than 500 employees work at the enterprise, including experienced specialists from Uzbekistan, as well as invited foreign experts from Turkey and India, ensuring the implementation of international quality standards.

kamalak.title: Kamalak
kamalak.description1: The SAMARQAND KAMALAK INVEST TEKSTIL plant was founded in 2018 and is located in the Samarkand region, Uzbekistan. The production capacity of the enterprise is focused on deep processing of cotton and production of high-quality yarn. The spinning mill has 23,040 spindles installed, ensuring a stable process of twisting and yarn production. Annual production is about 8,000 tons of yarn. More than 600 specialists work at the enterprise, a significant portion of whom are young qualified personnel.
kamalak.description2: The main specialization of the plant is the production of cotton yarn: • Carded (with straight end) — in the range from Ne 6/1 to Ne 20/1; • Open End (with open end) — in the range from Ne 6/1 to Ne 20/1; • Slub — in the range from Ne 6/1 to Ne 30/1; • Lycra and Dual Core — in the range from Ne 6/1 to Ne 20/1.

ourServises.processTitle: Cotton Yarn Production Process — Sifat Textile
ourServises.processIntro: At Sifat Textile, we produce yarn that meets international quality standards. Every stage of the process combines modern technologies, precise engineering, and strict control. This ensures high strength, stable parameters, and exceptional fiber purity.
ourServises.process1Text: The process begins with selecting and evaluating cotton fiber. It is checked for length, purity, moisture, and grade. Only cotton that meets quality requirements proceeds further.
ourServises.process2Text: Automated lines remove impurities and blend the cotton evenly. This ensures batch stability, which is critical for high‑quality yarn.
ourServises.process3Text: Modern opening machines gently separate fibers, creating a uniform airy mass. This enhances material structure and ensures smooth processing in later stages.
ourServises.process4Text: One of the key stages at Sifat Textile. Carding machines: align fibers, clean them up to 98%, form an even carded sliver. Here the foundation of strong and uniform yarn is formed.
ourServises.process5Text: For Combed Compact yarn, the sliver undergoes combing. Short and weak fibers are removed, resulting in extremely clean, long‑fibered, and stable material.
ourServises.process6Text: Multiple slivers are combined, aligned, and stabilized. They then become roving — the intermediate material essential for perfect spinning.
ourServises.process7Text: A major strength of Sifat Textile is the use of world‑class machinery. Spinning machines provide: uniform drafting, precise twist, low hairiness, high strength. Compact technology ensures a clean surface and consistent yarn parameters.
ourServises.process8Text: During winding, knots, thick places, and defects are removed. Each bobbin undergoes tests for: tensile strength, evenness, twist stability, humidity and purity. All processes comply with international standards.
ourServises.process9Text: Finished yarn is pressed or vacuum‑packed, wrapped, and labeled according to customer requirements. Sifat Textile guarantees quality preservation at all stages of storage and transport.
ourServises.processConclusion: Why customers choose Sifat Textile: — Modern production technologies — Fiber purity and stability — International quality standards — High uniformity and strength — Strict control at every stage
